items.title: Rheumatology conditions with only partial MCC-presentation evidence
items.summary: SLE, antiphospholipid antibody syndrome, ANCA-associated vasculitis, and enteropathic arthritis have no dedicated canonical MCC objective located by targeted search. Each retains only a documented WEAK citation with requires_scope_review=true rather than an invented mapping.
items.recommended_action: Recheck after an MCC registry refresh; retain presentation recognition, initial investigation, urgent escalation, and referral without treating the cited objective as comprehensive disease coverage.

items.title: Thrombotic, visual-risk, and inflammatory-bowel overlap retained in rheumatology
items.summary: APS, giant-cell-arteritis visual risk, and enteropathic arthritis require hematology/obstetrics, ophthalmology, and gastroenterology linkage respectively. RH retains recognition and initial action only; no global ownership decision was made.
items.recommended_action: Resolve global ownership only after all chapters are mapped.

items.title: Rheumatology treatment regimens and thresholds require current guidance
items.summary: The chapter contains antimicrobial, glucocorticoid, DMARD/biologic, anticoagulation, and prophylaxis content that is deliberately not frozen at scope stage.
items.recommended_action: During question generation, verify all medication choices, doses, algorithms, and thresholds against current Canadian source guidance.
